description: Tube distortion: the signal is driven into a valve model, filtered before it gets there and levelled after it

params.text: Picks one of six valve models, from symmetrical clipping at one end of the arc to asymmetrical at the other
Sets the corner of the four-pole lowpass ahead of the valve, 500Hz at one end and 44000Hz at the other
Sets how hard the signal is driven into the valve
Sets the level of the output

inputs.text: Raises the drive, 5V covering the whole of the gain knob's travel
Shifts the filter corner, 1V moving it by about 2944Hz, with the total held between 500Hz and 44000Hz
The audio fed into the module, ±5V taken as full scale

outputs.text: The distorted signal, scaled by the output knob

inputs.0:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.1:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.2:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
